faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Can I upload my existing subtitle file and burn it into video?
faq.a1: Yes! Upload your video and your existing .SRT, .VTT, .ASS, .SUB, .TXT, or .JSON subtitle file. You can choose any animated style, adjust sync offsets, and export a high-resolution MP4 with hardcoded captions.
faq.q2: How accurate is the AI subtitle generation?
faq.a2: FreeAutoCaption uses OpenAI Whisper on Cloudflare Workers AI edge GPUs, delivering 99%+ word-level accuracy with automatic punctuation and multi-language support.
faq.q3: Is there a watermark on the exported video?
faq.a3: No! All video exports and subtitle downloads on FreeAutoCaption are 100% free and completely watermark-free.
faq.q4: Does my video get uploaded to a third-party server?
faq.a4: Your video is processed directly in your browser using modern Web Audio and Canvas rendering. Only the lightweight audio track is processed for transcription.
faq.q5: What video and subtitle formats are supported?
faq.a5: Videos: MP4, MOV, WEBM, MKV, M4V. Audios: MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC. Subtitles: SRT, VTT, ASS, SSA, SUB, TXT, JSON.
